4 of 6 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review

Vani Desta walked the committee through the Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review proposal. The proposal aims to address long-standing issues affecting 43 employees in the 12 region. After a thorough debate on the budgetary impact and timeline, the committee moved to a formal resolution. All related materials were previously distributed as Exhibit A.

Item 2
Special Litigation Matter Update

The Special Litigation Matter Update was a review of the company's compliance with contract laws. The committee reviewed the company's contracting process and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Motion

To note for the record: RESOLVED, that the Equity Awards Committee approves the public disclosure of the Special Litigation Matter Update in the company's upcoming proxy statement.

Moved: Vani Desta  •  Seconded: Adaeze Callahan
Vote: 3 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Shareholder Engagement Strategy — Proxy Season 2013

The committee reviewed the Shareholder Engagement Strategy — Proxy Season 2013, a proposal to enter the 12 market. The discussion focused on the competitive landscape and the regulatory hurdles. The committee approved a budget for a feasibility study.

Motion

To approve for mitigation: RESOLVED, that the Equity Awards Committee approves the recommended approach to Shareholder Engagement Strategy — Proxy Season 2013 as described in Exhibit C, subject to legal review to be completed within 15 days of this meeting.

Moved: Adaeze Callahan  •  Seconded: Gizem Tripathi
Vote: 3 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Internal Investigation Update — Matter 43

The meeting began with a review of the minutes from the prior session, which were approved without modification. The committee then turned to the main agenda item, Internal Investigation Update — Matter 43. Gizem Tripathi provided a 15-minute summary, followed by a Q&A session.

Motion

To approve for target: RESOLVED, that the Equity Awards Committee approves the minutes of the meeting held on 2013-05-09 as drafted and circulated.

Moved: Adaeze Callahan  •  Seconded: Concepcion Malone
Vote: 3 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
